note: English names for the species, items, moves and balls Emerald Imperium and Heart & Soul share. Both are built on pokeemerald-expansion, and Heart & Soul's indexes are Imperium's up to species 1488, item 681 and move 847. A ball's index is its position in the hack's ball list, from 0, and its cross id is PKHeX's ball number. A species with a form has the form's name in brackets. Neither hack's source, nor pokeemerald-expansion's, has a licence, so the names are PKHeX's for the engine's ids, and the indexes the engine has no name for are left out.
